settings.privacyDescription: Control whether OpenDesk may send basic usage data.

settings.privacySummary: OpenDesk does not send script or Flow source, screenshots, clipboard contents, OCR content, AI conversations, prompts, user input, full local paths, or raw error text.

settings.updateFailed: Could not update this setting. Your previous choice is unchanged.
settings.privacyP1: When Help improve OpenDesk is enabled, OpenDesk sends only controlled basic usage information to understand feature use and whether automation runs complete normally.
settings.privacyP2: OpenDesk does not send script or Flow source, screenshots, clipboard contents, OCR content, AI conversations, prompts, user input, full local paths, secrets, tokens, or raw error text.
settings.privacyP3: When enabled, OpenDesk creates a random installation identifier to distinguish repeated use and sessions. It does not use machine serial numbers, MAC addresses, disk or CPU identifiers, License IDs, or account IDs. Turning this off stops accepting new basic usage data and revokes the local analytics identifier.
